dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Interested? Well then, buy the paper!

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Of course, if you're too lazy to read, you can also look for Sir Arthur. It will tell you about the latest news.

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: But if you're looking for news that isn't reported in the papers, you'll have some trouble finding it.
